ra: The I AM/CUT Aquarian-age hierarch is a devotional cult-form/reception of the existing Theosophical Master Saint Germain (Rakoczi).
Saint Germain is a chief master of the Great White Brotherhood in I AM/CUT teaching.
Lady Master Nada is enumerated among the Ascended Masters of the Great White Brotherhood.
The I AM/CUT Great White Brotherhood is the reception of the earlier Theosophical Masters of Wisdom (Mahatmas) as a named devotional collective.
The Great White Brotherhood corresponds to the Theosophical Spiritual Hierarchy reframed for the I AM/CUT movements.
El Morya is a primary master of the Great White Brotherhood and was the founding sponsor of CUT (the Summit Lighthouse).
Koot Hoomi (Master K.H.) is invoked as a master of the Great White Brotherhood in I AM/CUT teaching.
Sanat Kumara is venerated in CUT as a great being associated with the hierarchy of the Great White Brotherhood.
Maitreya, the World Teacher, is counted among the masters of the Great White Brotherhood in I AM/CUT cosmology.
Saint Germain is the master of the seventh ray and sponsor of the Violet Flame in I AM/CUT devotion.
The Violet Flame is the seventh of the Theosophical Seven Rays as developed in the I AM/CUT teaching.
Lady Master Nada is identified as Chohan of the sixth of the Seven Rays.
The Mighty I AM Presence as the individualized God-self is loosely correlated with the higher divine source in the broader Theosophical cosmology.
In I AM/CUT decree practice the Violet Flame is invoked in the name of and through the Mighty I AM Presence.
